summary: REE Automotive Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the Israeli District Court's approval to continue restructuring proceedings under Amendment No. 9 to the Israeli Insolvency Law. The stay of proceedings was extended through August 16, 2026, with creditors to submit proofs of claim by August 12, 2026. The company operates under a court-appointed arrangement manager while advancing a proposed debt arrangement and financing. Additionally, CFO Hai Aviv departed by mutual agreement on July 16, 2026, unrelated to any operational disagreement. No specific financial terms or advisor names were disclosed. Watch for court approval and stakeholder support milestones.
